name: google-services-mcps
description: MCP servers for Google Cloud, Google Workspace, Google Search and Google Business. One plugin per category: install only what you need.

plugins.name: google-cloud
plugins.description: Google Cloud console: projects, APIs, API keys, IAM, monitoring, logging, billing, data services, Compute Engine

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Tasks, People, Chat, and admin (users, org units, groups)

plugins.name: google-search
plugins.description: Google Search: Search Console sites, sitemaps, analytics, URL inspection, Custom Search, site verification, Indexing API

plugins.name: google-business
plugins.description: Google Business: Analytics, Tag Manager, YouTube, Business Profile
